create.assignmentHint: Accounts created by a store manager are always Store staff at this store. Contact an admin for other roles or stores.
create.enableNowHelper: If off, the account is created but can't log in yet
create.nextStepBasic: Fill in their phone, address and other basic details
create.nextStepSensitive: Submit their birthday, bank, super and ID details for your review
create.emailHelper: Used to log in, receive the initial password and reset a forgotten password
create.usernameFromEmailHelper: Same as the email by default and used to log in. Edit if needed (3–50 characters)
create.successDescriptionEmail: The initial password has been emailed to {{name}}. They log in to the app with it and set their own password the first time. You don't need to pass on any password.
create.inviteFailed: The account was created, but the initial password email was not sent: {{reason}}. You can resend it later.
create.nextStepEmail: Check their email, log in with the initial password and set their own password
create.loginEnabledOnHelper: When on, an initial password is emailed to them so they can log in to the app and web
create.loginEnabledOffHelper: Off by default: the account still works for attendance, rosters and so on, but can't log in to the app or web, and no password email is sent. You can turn it on later when editing
create.emailHelperNoLogin: Used for contact and account recovery only. The account can't log in yet
create.usernameFromEmailHelperNoLogin: Same as the email by default. Used to log in once login is allowed (3–50 characters)
create.successDescriptionNoLogin: {{name}}'s account was created. They can't log in to the app or web yet, and no password email was sent.
create.loginDisabledNotice: This staff member can't log in yet. When needed, edit them in the staff list and turn on "Allow app and web login"; you'll be asked whether to send the initial password.
